title: Conflicted Records: Typed Adversarial Contracts for Auditable LLM Output Quality Enforcement
title_zh: 冲突记录：用于可审计LLM输出质量执行的类型化对抗契约

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated records increasingly populate production information systems where they are treated as data assets subject to the same quality expectations as records from operational databases. A single such record can simultaneously satisfy and violate a quality rule: a grounded fact adjacent to a hallucination, a useful answer adjacent to a stereotype. Classical data cleaning cannot resolve this because the two judgments are incompatible over the same span; a single LLM judge cannot either, since it shares the training biases that produced the conflict. Existing interventions such as prompt engineering, chain-of-thought, and RLHF reduce surface error rates but provide no audit trail and cannot distinguish genuine remediation from blanket suppression. The question is whether a deterministic check over structured inter-agent records can catch the defects that referential checks alone miss.

paragraphs.en: We present BiasGuard-D: two adversarial roles drawn from distinct model families exchange typed claim documents, a three-model quorum adjudicates by majority vote, and a combined referential-plus-semantic invariant validates the verdict. The semantic component fires on verdicts referential checks miss; removing the iterative loop drops invariant satisfaction sharply. The deliberation layer transfers from stereotype to hallucination remediation on HaluEval QA with only role-framing changes, raising right-answer recovery by 49 percentage points; the triage gate required a cross-family second auditor to maintain recall on objective hallucination. Every claim, vote, and instruction is stored as a typed record giving operators a provenance trail auditable under emerging AI regulations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 BiasGuard-D：来自不同模型家族的两个对抗性角色交换带类型的论断文档，由三个模型组成的仲裁团通过多数投票进行裁决，并使用引用与语义相结合的不变量来验证裁决结果。 语义组件能够捕捉引用检查遗漏的裁决；移除迭代循环后，不变量满足率急剧下降。 仅通过改变角色设定，该协商层即可从刻板印象治理迁移到 HaluEval QA 上的幻觉修复，将正确答案的恢复率提升 49 个百分点；为在客观幻觉上保持召回率，分流门控需要一个跨家族的第二审计员。 每个论断、投票和指令都以带类型的记录形式存储，为运营者提供可在新兴人工智能法规下审计的溯源链条。

paragraphs.en: LLM outputs are no longer transient. They are persisted into search indexes, written into knowledge bases, embedded in recommendation feeds, and surfaced through customer-facing information systems where they act as data [ 17 , 8 ] . As deployments scale into regulated domains, operators need more than a quality score; they need to know why an output passes or fails a constraint, which span triggered the verdict, and whether the remediation instructions are internally consistent .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 的输出不再是短暂的。 它们被持久化到搜索索引中，被写入知识库，被嵌入推荐信息流，并通过面向客户的信息系统呈现出来，在其中充当数据 [ 17 , 8 ] 。 随着部署扩展到受监管的领域，运营者需要的不仅仅是一个质量分数；他们需要知道为什么某个输出通过或未通过某项约束，是哪个片段触发了判定，以及修复指令在内部是否一致。

paragraphs.en: What makes this hard is that an LLM-generated record can satisfy and violate a quality rule in the same sequence of text. A hiring recommendation may accurately ground its reasoning in a candidate’s qualifications while simultaneously making an age generalisation the input does not support. A knowledge-base entry may pair a faithfully lifted fact with one the model invented. In neither case are the two things in separate fields or even separate sentences; they share the same characters. Classical data cleaning, which reads a record and refines it, cannot resolve this, because the two issues require opposite judgments about the same text. A single LLM judge cannot either, since it shares the same training biases that produced the conflict [ 15 , 25 , 26 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这之所以困难，是因为LLM生成的记录可以在同一段文本中既满足又违反某条质量规则。 一条招聘推荐可能将其推理准确地锚定在候选人的资历上，同时又做出输入并不支持的年龄概括。 一条知识库条目可能将一个忠实提取的事实与一个模型编造的事实放在一起。 在这两种情况下，两者都不在单独的字段中，甚至不在单独的句子中；它们共享相同的字符。 读取记录并对其进行精炼的经典数据清洗无法解决这一问题，因为这两个问题需要对同一文本做出相反的判断。 单个LLM评判者同样无法解决，因为它具有与产生该冲突相同的训练偏差 [ 15 , 25 , 26 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The question this paper asks is: can a deterministic check over structured inter-agent records catch the quality defects that referential checks alone miss, and do those records carry enough information to audit pipeline quality without calling an additional model? We evaluate this across three dimensions: whether a semantic check catches a recurring class of contradictions that referential checks miss; whether stored records carry enough structure to tell genuine resolution from suppression without calling a further model; and whether the deliberation layer transfers across different quality domains with only role-framing changes.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出的问题是：对结构化的智能体间记录进行确定性检查，能否捕获仅靠引用性检查会遗漏的质量缺陷，以及这些记录是否携带足够的信息，使得无需调用额外模型即可审计流水线质量？ 我们从三个维度进行评估：语义检查能否捕获引用性检查遗漏的一类反复出现的矛盾；存储的记录是否携带足够的结构信息，无需调用另一个模型即可区分真正的解决与压制；以及协商层能否在仅改变角色设定的情况下跨不同质量领域迁移。

paragraphs.en: We address this by treating enforcement as a data-quality problem rather than a single-judge problem: two adversarial roles with opposing biases produce structured claims about specific text spans; a multi-family quorum adjudicates; and a deterministic invariant validates the result before any downstream action. Records with a consistent verdict pass with a full provenance trail; contradictory verdicts are quarantined rather than auto-repaired, because auto-repair would bring back the model judgment the architecture is designed to avoid. The experimental study confirms all three evaluation questions and surfaces a finding we did not anticipate: the iterative deliberation loop matters far more than any individual model choice, and the audit trail is what makes this visible.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将强制执行视为数据质量问题而非单一裁判问题来解决这一问题：两个带有相反偏见的对抗角色针对特定文本片段生成结构化声明；由多模型家族组成的仲裁团进行裁决；并在任何下游操作之前由确定性不变式验证结果。 裁决一致的记录在通过时附带完整的溯源链；裁决相互矛盾的记录会被隔离而非自动修复，因为自动修复会重新引入该架构本要避免的模型判断。 实验研究确认了全部三个评估问题，并揭示了一个我们没有预料到的发现：迭代式审议循环远比任何单独的模型选择更重要，而审计链正是使这一点得以显现的关键。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions. We present a five-stage typed adversarial contract pipeline in which two adversarial roles from distinct model families exchange typed claim documents over bounded peer-to-peer rounds, a three-model quorum adjudicates, and a combined deterministic invariant ( ℐ ref ∧ ℐ sem \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{ref}}\wedge\mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{sem}} ) validates each verdict, making the full lineage from any instruction back to its originating span queryable as data. An ablation shows that the iterative deliberation loop accounts for most of the invariant-satisfaction gain: removing the loop drops satisfaction by nearly 30 percentage points on the BBQ Disability benchmark, while schema-level coordination metrics stored as typed records make the degradation auditable without calling an additional model. Finally, we provide cross-domain portability evidence showing that the deliberation layer, data model, and invariant transfer from subjective stereotype remediation to objective hallucination remediation by changing only role-framing prompts; the triage gate required a cross-family second auditor to maintain recall on objective hallucination, isolating the gate as the one domain-sensitive component.
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出三项贡献。 我们提出了一个五阶段类型化对抗契约流水线，其中来自不同模型家族的两个对抗角色在有限轮次的对等交互中交换类型化声明文档，由三个模型组成的法定人数进行裁决，并由组合确定性不变式 ( ℐ ref ∧ ℐ sem \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{ref}}\wedge\mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{sem}} ) 验证每个裁决，使得从任意指令回溯到其来源片段的完整谱系可以作为数据进行查询。 消融实验表明，迭代 deliberation 循环贡献了不变式满足度提升的大部分：移除该循环会使 BBQ Disability 基准上的满足度下降近 30 个百分点，而以类型化记录形式存储的模式级协调指标使这种退化可被审计，且无需调用额外模型。 最后，我们提供了跨领域可移植性证据，表明该 deliberation 层、数据模型和不变式只需通过更改角色设定提示，即可从主观刻板印象修复迁移到客观幻觉修复；分诊门控需要一个跨家族的第二审计员以在客观幻觉任务上保持召回率，从而将门控隔离为唯一的领域敏感组件。

paragraphs.en: BiasGuard-D sits at the intersection of classical data quality, LLM output enforcement, and typed-contract agent orchestration. Each tradition contributes something the system needs; none alone addresses the conflicted-record problem.
paragraphs.zh: BiasGuard-D 位于经典数据质量、LLM 输出约束与类型化契约的智能体编排三者的交汇点上。 每一传统都贡献了该系统所需的某些东西；但没有哪一个能单独解决冲突记录问题。

sents.en: Each tradition contributes something the system needs; none alone addresses the conflicted-record problem.

paragraphs.en: The standard view of data quality treats records as entities that satisfy or violate integrity constraints, and routing or repairing violators is a long-studied problem [ 10 , 14 , 3 , 5 ] . Our invariant is recognisable in this tradition: ℐ ref \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{ref}} is a foreign-key coverage check, and ℐ sem \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{sem}} resembles near-duplicate detection in entity resolution. Classical repair theory selects a minimal change to restore integrity, but a span instructed both to be removed and preserved cannot be fixed this way; there is no ordering on natural-language paraphrases that singles out a canonical repair. BiasGuard-D quarantines on ℐ sem \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{sem}} failure rather than attempting an auto-repair, because doing so would bring model judgment back into the verification step. The novelty lies not in either predicate alone but in applying them together over natural-language payloads.
paragraphs.zh: 关于数据质量的标准观点将记录视为满足或违反完整性约束的实体，而对违规记录进行路由或修复是一个经过长期研究的问题 [ 10 , 14 , 3 , 5 ] 。 我们的不变量在这一传统中是可以辨认的：ℐ ref \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{ref}} 是一种外键覆盖检查，而 ℐ sem \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{sem}} 类似于实体解析中的近似重复检测。 经典修复理论选择最小的改动来恢复完整性，但一个既被指示要被移除又被指示要被保留的片段无法以这种方式修复；自然语言释义上不存在能够挑出一个规范修复的排序。 BiasGuard-D 在 ℐ sem \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{sem}} 失败时采取隔离而非尝试自动修复，因为这样做会把模型判断重新带入验证步骤。 新颖之处不在于其中任何一个谓词本身，而在于将它们共同应用于自然语言载荷之上。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented and self-refining pipelines [ 17 , 8 , 1 ] read, refine, and pass on records. This works well for straightforward quality issues but fails on conflicted records because no stage can mark two co-located spans as simultaneously valid and invalid. Recent multi-agent debate [ 7 , 18 ] introduces structured disagreement but without typed message formats or deterministic verification. Related work in the group has studied agent disagreement as a diagnostic signal for moderation [ 23 ] , applied dialectical multi-agent refinement to structured classification [ 4 ] , and used community-driven agent frameworks for implicit bias detection [ 12 ] . Training-time approaches (Constitutional AI [ 2 ] and RLHF [ 20 ] ) embed quality constraints into model parameters; the resulting guarantees are statistical and opaque to an auditor. A single-model pipeline that produces a cleaner-looking output provides no evidence that the conflict was resolved rather than suppressed. BiasGuard-D is runtime, record-level, and inspectable: every inter-stage exchange is a typed record rather than a raw string.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强与自我改进的流水线 [ 17 , 8 , 1 ] 读取、精炼并传递记录。 这种方法对于简单的质量问题效果良好，但对于存在冲突的记录则会失败，因为没有任何阶段能够将两个相邻的片段同时标记为有效和无效。 近期的多智能体辩论方法 [ 7 , 18 ] 引入了结构化的分歧，但缺乏类型化的消息格式或确定性的验证。 本课题组的有关工作将智能体分歧作为审核的诊断信号进行了研究 [ 23 ] ，将辩证的多智能体精炼方法应用于结构化分类 [ 4 ] ，并利用社区驱动的智能体框架进行隐性偏见检测 [ 12 ] 。 训练时方法（Constitutional AI [ 2 ] 和 RLHF [ 20 ] ）将质量约束嵌入模型参数之中；由此产生的保证是统计性的，且对审计者而言是不透明的。 产生看起来更干净输出的单模型流水线，无法提供任何证据表明冲突是被解决了而非被压制了。 BiasGuard-D 是运行时的、记录级别的、可检查的：每次阶段间的交换都是一条类型化的记录，而非原始字符串。

paragraphs.en: Typed inter-agent messaging descends from FIPA contract-net protocols [ 11 , 21 ] , was revived in LLM orchestration frameworks [ 24 , 16 ] , and has acquired formal treatment in Hoare-style contracts [ 6 ] . Because every inter-stage record conforms to a fixed schema, the full lineage from any instruction back to its source is stored and queryable without re-running the models. Prior work supplies the message-passing machinery but does not apply it to adversarial quality enforcement with a deterministic check across different constraint types.
paragraphs.zh: 类型化的智能体间消息传递源自 FIPA 合同网协议 [11, 21]，在大语言模型编排框架中得以复兴 [24, 16]，并在 Hoare 风格的契约中获得了形式化处理 [6]。 由于每个阶段间的记录都符合固定的模式，从任意指令回溯到其来源的完整谱系都被存储下来，并且无需重新运行模型即可查询。 已有工作提供了消息传递机制，但并未将其应用于对抗性质量执行，也未通过跨不同约束类型的确定性检查来实施质量保障。

paragraphs.en: Making the problem precise requires moving from record-level pass/fail to span-level decomposition. A record that must simultaneously preserve one span and remove another cannot be handled as a unit: each span needs an identified role, and the roles assigned by different judges need to be checked for mutual consistency before any downstream action.
paragraphs.zh: 让问题变得精确，需要从记录级别的通过/失败判定转向跨度级别的分解。 一条必须同时保留某个跨度又移除另一个跨度的记录，无法作为一个单元来处理：每个跨度都需要一个明确的角色，而且不同评审者所分配的角色需要先检查其相互一致性，才能进行任何下游操作。

paragraphs.en: Concretely: an operator maintaining an AI-generated catalogue needs both span-level granularity to approve or remove individual claims without discarding the whole entry, and a provenance trail linking each instruction back to its source span, auditable without re-running the pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言：维护 AI 生成目录的操作者既需要跨度级别的粒度，以便在不丢弃整个条目的情况下批准或删除单个声明，也需要一条溯源链，将每条指令回溯到其来源跨度，并且无需重新运行流水线即可进行审计。

paragraphs.en: Both scenarios impose the same requirement on the data model: span-level typed claims with stable identifiers, a deterministic consistency check that needs no model at verification time, and a stored lineage that survives the full pipeline. The data model described next is designed around exactly these three requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 两种场景对数据模型提出了相同的要求：带有稳定标识符的span级类型化断言（claim）、在验证时无需模型的确定性一致性检查，以及能在整个流水线中留存下来的谱系信息（lineage）。 下一节描述的数据模型正是围绕这三个要求设计的。

paragraphs.en: Every correctness property of BiasGuard-D rests on the data model, so we describe it before the pipeline. Record-level pass/fail labels are insufficient for quality assessment: locating where errors occur requires finer-grained units [ 13 , 22 ] . Two design decisions follow from the problem. First, fixing schemas up-front means stages can be swapped or upgraded without ambiguity, which matters as models are deprecated. Second, grounding all schemas in a single atomic primitive means the consistency invariant operates on stable identifier sets rather than on natural-language content, keeping verification deterministic and LLM-free.
paragraphs.zh: BiasGuard-D 的每一条正确性性质都建立在数据模型之上，因此我们先描述数据模型，再介绍流水线。 仅靠记录级别的通过/失败标签不足以进行质量评估：定位错误发生的位置需要更细粒度的单元 [ 13 , 22 ] 。 由此得出两个设计决策。 第一，预先固定模式意味着各个阶段可以在无歧义的情况下被替换或升级，这一点在模型被弃用时尤为重要。 第二，将所有模式都建立在同一个原子原语之上，意味着一致性不变量作用于稳定的标识符集合而非自然语言内容，从而使验证保持确定性且无需使用大语言模型。

paragraphs.en: The primitive is an AtomicClaim : one identifiable assertion about a specific text span. Each claim carries a role-prefixed identifier ( C001 for the Stereotype Advocate’s first claim, D001 for the Context Defender’s), the verbatim or compressed span it concerns, a typed claim category drawn from five values ( Factual , Rhetorical , Framing , OptionPreference , DecisionFlip ), an optional list of provenance identifiers from a reference passage, and a confidence score. The role prefix makes cross-role provenance trivial to compute: finding where SA and CD claims overlap is a string-prefix operation, not a semantic search. Confidence is discounted multiplicatively each time the opposing role contests a claim, so four contestations reduce it by roughly two-thirds rather than collapsing it to zero; the trajectory is stored per round and flags cases where a low-confidence claim is nevertheless upheld. Full field definitions and the Python implementation are in the repository.
paragraphs.zh: 该原语是一个原子声明（AtomicClaim）：即关于特定文本片段的一条可识别断言。 每条声明带有一个角色前缀标识符（刻板印象倡导者的第一条声明为 C001，语境捍卫者的为 D001）、其所涉及的逐字或压缩文本片段、一个取自五个取值的类型化声明类别（Factual、Rhetorical、Framing、OptionPreference、DecisionFlip）、一个指向参考段落的可选来源标识符列表，以及一个置信度分数。 角色前缀使得跨角色来源的计算变得极为简单：查找智能体 A 与智能体 B 声明的重叠之处只需字符串前缀操作，而无需语义搜索。 每当对方角色的智能体质疑某条声明时，置信度会被乘性折减，因此四次质疑大约会将其降低三分之二，而不是使其直接归零；该轨迹按轮次存储，并标记出那些置信度较低却仍被坚持的声明。 完整的字段定义和 Python 实现见代码仓库。

paragraphs.en: The Generator (Llama 3.1 8B via Groq) produces the incoming record from structured input; the Auditor (same model, same family) emits a VerdictContract carrying a delegate flag. Pairing the Auditor with the Generator’s own family is deliberate: self-preference bias means a same-family judge is less likely to flag its own family’s outputs [ 15 , 25 ] , so records it does flag are ones where even a sympathetic reading finds a problem, making it a high-precision, if lower-recall, triage gate. The deliberation pipeline is invoked sparingly and only on records the same-family judge cannot explain away; the recall cost is the precision-recall trade-off the architecture already surfaces at the delegation threshold. Records where delegate=false pass through unchanged; otherwise they enter deliberation. For the cross-domain HaluEval condition a second cross-family Auditor B (Mistral Small) is added; delegation is OR(A, B) , raising recall at the cost of additional false delegations on correct inputs.

paragraphs.en: The Stereotype Advocate (SA, GLM-4-Flash via Zhipu AI) and the Context Defender (CD, Mistral Small via Mistral AI) produce their initial StereotypeCase and ContextDefense in round one. In each subsequent round each role reads the other’s previous document and re-emits its own, reusing the prior round’s claim_id when a claim survives semantically and assigning a fresh identifier when a substantively new claim is raised. The stability check is deterministic and operates on identifier sets only: the loop terminates when two consecutive rounds produce identical contested and defended claim sets, or when a five-round cap is reached. The cap is set at roughly twice the empirically observed mean convergence point (2.24–2.39 rounds across conditions; Table 6 ): if claim sets have not stabilised by that point, continued exchange is unlikely to resolve the underlying tension, and the invariant will surface the contradiction at Stage 5 regardless. The two roles update in parallel within a round, so neither sees the other’s current-round output. Identifier mis-assignment by a role delays stability by at most one round; it does not compromise the invariant.
paragraphs.zh: 刻板印象倡导者（SA，通过智谱 AI 的 GLM-4-Flash）与语境辩护者（CD，通过 Mistral AI 的 Mistral Small）在第一轮生成各自的初始 StereotypeCase 与 ContextDefense。 在后续每一轮中，每个角色阅读对方上一轮的文档并重新输出自己的文档：当某个论断在语义上延续时，沿用上一轮的 claim_id；当提出实质性新论断时，则分配新的标识符。 稳定性检查是确定性的，且仅作用于标识符集合：当连续两轮产生完全相同的争议论断集合与辩护论断集合时，或达到五轮上限时，循环终止。 该上限被设定为大约两倍于经验观察到的平均收敛点（各条件下为 2.24–2.39 轮；表 6）：如果到那时论断集合尚未稳定，继续交换也不太可能化解根本性张力，而不变量无论如何都会在第 5 阶段揭示该矛盾。 两个角色在同一轮内并行更新，因此任何一方都看不到对方当前轮的输出。 某个角色对标识符的错误分配最多使稳定性推迟一轮；它不会损害该不变量。

paragraphs.en: Three Arbiters drawn from three distinct provider families (Cohere Command R, Claude Sonnet, and Llama 3.3 70B) receive the converged claim documents in parallel and each emit an independent DeliberationVerdict . A per-claim majority vote (at least two of three) produces the aggregated verdict, which then passes through the combined invariant (§ 3.4 ). If the invariant holds, the Generator is re-invoked with the upheld preserve, reframe, and drop instructions; if either component fails, an InvariantViolation record is logged and the pipeline emits a conservative fallback. The quarantine path deliberately avoids auto-repair: a verdict that fails the semantic check has gone through five stages of deliberation without resolving its contradiction, and patching it over would bring model judgment back into the verification step.
paragraphs.zh: 从三个不同的提供方系列（Cohere Command R、Claude Sonnet 和 Llama 3.3 70B）中选出的三个仲裁者并行接收收敛后的声明文档，各自输出一个独立的 DeliberationVerdict。 针对每条声明的多数投票（三者中至少两票）产生聚合裁决，该裁决随后通过组合不变式（§ 3.4）的检验。 如果不变式成立，生成器会依据被维持的保留、重述和删除指令被重新调用；如果任一组件失败，则会记录一条 InvariantViolation 记录，并且流水线输出一个保守的回退结果。 隔离路径刻意避免自动修复：一个未通过语义检查的裁决已经经历了五个阶段的审议仍未解决其矛盾，若强行修补它，会把模型判断重新带回验证步骤之中。

Same-family models show joint error correlations up to 60% regardless of prompt diversity, and single-family multi-agent setups systematically overstate coordination gains [ 15 , 25 ] . paragraphs.en: In plain terms: the SA and CD must not uphold claims about near-identical text spans, since that would instruct downstream to simultaneously remove and preserve the same content. Referential coverage passes such verdicts; the semantic check catches them. paragraphs.en: The experimental study tests each question against a specific condition: whether the semantic component adds value is tested by comparing ℐ ref \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{ref}} -only against the combined invariant across all datasets; whether stored records carry diagnostic value is tested by reading coordination metrics against output-level results on the same items; and whether the deliberation layer transfers is tested by running it on HaluEval QA with role-framing prompt changes and a cross-family second auditor at the triage gate.
paragraphs.zh: 实验研究针对每个问题检验特定条件：语义组件是否增加价值，通过在所有数据集上对比仅使用 ℐ ref \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{ref}} 与组合不变量来检验；存储记录是否具有诊断价值，通过在同一项目上对照输出级结果解读协调指标来检验；以及思辨层是否可迁移，通过在 HaluEval QA 上以角色框架提示词变更并在分诊关卡引入跨模型家族的第二审计者来运行以检验。

paragraphs.en: Three classes of metric carry the analysis. Data-quality metrics : satisfaction rate of ℐ ref ∧ ℐ sem \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{ref}}\wedge\mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{sem}} and each component separately, and the resulting quarantine rate. These are computed as set operations on stored records with no model call, making them usable as production monitoring signals. Coordination metrics : P2P stability rate (fraction of items whose claim-id sets reach a fixed point before the five-round cap), mean deliberation rounds, and inter-Arbiter agreement. Application-level outcomes : for BBQ, the stereotyped-option pick rate (lower is better); for HaluEval, the hallucination-removal rate and right-answer match rate on hallucinated inputs, and the preservation rate on correct inputs.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 places BiasGuard-D alongside three simpler interventions on BBQ Age ( n = 115 n{=}115 ): zero-shot (ZS), a stereotype-aware system prompt (SDP), and chain-of-thought (CoT).
paragraphs.zh: 表3将 BiasGuard-D 与三种更简单的干预方法在 BBQ Age（n=115n{=}115）数据集上进行了对比：零样本（ZS）、刻板印象感知系统提示（SDP）和思维链（CoT）。

paragraphs.en: CoT’s 0% stereotype rate is the most instructive number in Table 3 , and not in CoT’s favour. It is achieved not by reasoning about each item but by routing 108 of 115 answers to “can’t be determined” irrespective of the question. The model has learned to suppress rather than reason. SDP shows the same pattern on a lesser scale: neutral responses rise from 30.4% under ZS to 65.2% under SDP, and within-item shift analysis finds zero classification changes: every item that was stereotyped under ZS remained stereotyped under SDP, and vice versa. The aggregate rate difference between ZS and SDP reflects a model-calibration shift, not item-level remediation; and like CoT, SDP leaves no record of which spans were judged problematic or why. BiasGuard-D produces a smaller raw reduction ( − - 11.3pp), but every verdict is a typed, diagnosable record; CoT and SDP “succeed” by suppression, leaving nothing to audit and no way to tell whether it is principled or reflexive.
paragraphs.zh: CoT 的 0% 刻板印象率是表 3 中最具启发性的数字，但并非对 CoT 有利。 这个结果并非通过对每个条目进行推理而实现，而是无视问题内容，将 115 个回答中的 108 个路由到“无法判定”。 模型学到的是抑制，而非推理。 SDP 在较小规模上呈现出同样的模式：中性回答从 ZS 下的 30.4% 上升到 SDP 下的 65.2%，且条目内变化分析发现分类变化为零：所有在 ZS 下被刻板印象化的条目在 SDP 下依然被刻板印象化，反之亦然。 ZS 与 SDP 之间的总体比率差异反映的是模型校准的偏移，而非条目层面的修正；而且与 CoT 一样，SDP 没有留下任何记录说明哪些片段被判定有问题以及为什么。 BiasGuard-D 带来的原始降幅较小（−11.3pp），但每个判定都是有类型的、可诊断的记录；CoT 和 SDP 通过抑制来“取得成功”，既没有留下任何可供审计的内容，也无法判断这种成功是有原则的还是反射性的。

paragraphs.en: The size of the violating class depends on task and deliberation mode. The clearest comparison is BBQ Disability, where the two configurations share identical 36 delegated items: under SR-Med the semantic violation rate is 44.4% (Wilson 95% CI [ 29.5 , 60.4 ] [29.5,\,60.4] ), under P2P it falls to 16.7% ( [ 7.9 , 31.9 ] [7.9,\,31.9] ), and the intervals do not overlap. BBQ Age under SR-Med has only a 2.6% violation rate, not because mediated deliberation resolved anything, but because the Age items rarely produce near-duplicate SA/CD claims to begin with. The semantic invariant is not a theoretical safeguard; it is what separates a resolved contradiction from a suppressed one, and its failure rate varies predictably with the task.

paragraphs.en: The HaluEval condition makes the converse point. Inter-Arbiter agreement is 0.98 on the hallucinated inputs, far above the 0.49–0.57 range on BBQ. This is not a calibration effect; it reflects that an objective grounding task gives heterogeneous Arbiters something concrete to converge on. Subjective stereotype categories leave room for genuine disagreement, and the typed records preserve that disagreement rather than smooth it over. The coordination metrics thus carry diagnostic value beyond pick rate or removal rate, telling an operator whether deliberation is converging or simply running out the clock.
paragraphs.zh: HaluEval 条件说明了相反的观点。 在被幻觉污染的输入上，仲裁者之间的一致率为 0.98，远高于 BBQ 上 0.49–0.57 的区间。 这并非校准效应，而是反映了一个客观的接地任务能让异质的仲裁者有具体内容可以达成收敛。 主观刻板印象类别留下了真实分歧的空间，而带类型的记录保留了这种分歧，而不是将其抹平。 因此，这些协调性指标比采纳率或移除率具有更多的诊断价值，能让操作者判断审议是在真正收敛，还是仅仅在耗尽时间。

sents.en: The coordination metrics thus carry diagnostic value beyond pick rate or removal rate, telling an operator whether deliberation is converging or simply running out the clock.

paragraphs.en: The precision control on already-correct inputs tells the symmetric story. Of 50 right-answer records the dual auditor delegates 24, of which 11 are preserved verbatim and 13 become hedges, giving an overall preservation rate of 71.4%. Of the 24 false delegations, 19 fire because one auditor flags while the other passes; only 2 are consensus mis-flags. Requiring both auditors to agree before delegating would eliminate about 92% of false delegations on correct inputs, at the cost of routing 22% of true hallucinations through the pass-through path. This is the standard recall-precision trade-off, and the architecture exposes it at the one stage where an operator can tune it without touching the data model, quorum, or invariant.
paragraphs.zh: 对已正确输入的精度控制讲述了一个对称的故事。 在50条正确答案记录中，双审计员委托了24条，其中11条被原样保留，13条变为含糊表述，整体保留率为71.4%。 在24次错误委托中，有19次是因为一名审计员标记而另一名放行；只有2次是共识性的错误标记。 要求两名审计员一致同意才进行委托，可以在正确输入上消除约92%的错误委托，但代价是让22%的真实幻觉经由放行路径通过。 这是标准的召回率与精确率权衡，而该架构将其暴露在唯一一个操作者无需改动数据模型、法定人数或不变量即可进行调节的阶段。

paragraphs.en: Three threads extend beyond the experimental numbers: where the architecture matters in practice, what the cross-domain transfer demonstrated, and where the current design falls short.
paragraphs.zh: 有三条线索超越了实验数据本身：架构在实践中何处重要、跨领域迁移证明了什么，以及当前设计还有哪些不足。

paragraphs.en: The conflicted-record problem arises wherever LLM-generated text is treated as a data asset. In content moderation , advocate roles become a removal-advocate and a preservation-advocate; the invariant catches the case where both ask for incompatible actions on overlapping spans. In knowledge-base ingestion , a grounding-advocate and a contextualisation-advocate produce claims over extracted facts, and the invariant prevents a verdict from simultaneously asserting and retracting the same fact. In privacy-versus-utility data release , a privacy-advocate and a utility-advocate flag the same spans for opposite reasons; the architecture surfaces this conflict as typed records a data steward can audit, rather than burying it in a classifier score.
paragraphs.zh: 只要LLM生成的文本被当作数据资产处理，冲突记录问题就会出现。 在内容审核中，倡导者角色变为删除倡导者与保留倡导者；该不变式捕捉的是两者对重叠片段要求不相容操作的情形。 在知识库摄取中，接地倡导者与情境化倡导者对提取出的事实生成断言，该不变式防止一个判定同时断言并撤回同一事实。 在隐私与效用权衡的数据发布中，隐私倡导者与效用倡导者基于相反的理由标记相同的片段；该架构将这一冲突以类型化记录的形式呈现给数据管理员以供审计，而不是将其埋没在分类器分数之中。

paragraphs.en: Two limitations bear on the evidence. The LLM-as-judge step that produced the HaluEval hallucination-removal labels is itself subject to the same biases the architecture is designed to catch. We mitigate by giving the judge a strict comparison prompt with no reference to intermediate records, but a fully independent human judge would eliminate this concern entirely.

paragraphs.en: Four directions extend the current system. First, auditor configuration: switching from OR to AND delegation, so that both auditors must agree before escalating, eliminates roughly 92% of false delegations on correct inputs without additional inference cost, at the cost of routing some true hallucinations through the pass-through path; evaluating this trade-off systematically across domain types is the nearest-term engineering extension. A three-auditor majority vote would break most ties but multiplies cost across the full record stream, making it less practical at deployment scale. Second, the Jaccard threshold has been validated only on the current BBQ and HaluEval distributions; paraphrase-rich corpora where surface overlap is low but semantic overlap is high may require a dense-embedding similarity check to replace or supplement it. Third, the portability claim currently rests on two domains; extending to content moderation, knowledge-base ingestion, and privacy-versus-utility data release would establish whether only role-framing changes suffice at the triage gate, or whether the invariant itself needs domain-specific extension. Fourth, replacing the LLM-as-judge evaluation labels with independent human annotation would strengthen the HaluEval evidence base, and identifying a fully free-tier Arbiter matching Claude Sonnet-level performance on objective hallucination tasks remains an open engineering problem.
paragraphs.zh: 四个方向可扩展当前系统。 第一，审计员配置：将或委托切换为与委托，即两名审计员必须都同意才能升级上报，这可在正确输入上消除约92%的误委托，且不增加推理成本，代价是让部分真实的幻觉经由直通路径通过；跨领域类型系统地评估这一权衡是最近期的工程扩展。 三名审计员的多数投票可以打破大多数平局，但会使整条记录流的成本成倍增加，因此在部署规模上较不实用。 第二，Jaccard 阈值仅在当前的 BBQ 和 HaluEval 分布上得到验证；对于表面重合度低但语义重合度高的改写丰富的语料，可能需要用稠密嵌入相似度检查来替换或补充它。 第三，目前的可移植性结论仅基于两个领域；扩展到内容审核、知识库摄取以及隐私与效用权衡的数据发布，将能确定在分诊门控处仅改变角色设定是否足够，还是该不变式本身需要针对领域进行扩展。 第四，用独立的人工标注替换大模型作为评判者的评估标签，将强化 HaluEval 的证据基础；而在客观幻觉任务上找到性能与 Claude Sonnet 相当的完全免费层级的仲裁者，仍是一个待解决的工程问题。

sents.en: Second, the Jaccard threshold has been validated only on the current BBQ and HaluEval distributions; paraphrase-rich corpora where surface overlap is low but semantic overlap is high may require a dense-embedding similarity check to replace or supplement it.
sents.zh: 第二，Jaccard 阈值仅在当前的 BBQ 和 HaluEval 分布上得到验证；对于表面重合度低但语义重合度高的改写丰富的语料，可能需要用稠密嵌入相似度检查来替换或补充它。

sents.en: Third, the portability claim currently rests on two domains; extending to content moderation, knowledge-base ingestion, and privacy-versus-utility data release would establish whether only role-framing changes suffice at the triage gate, or whether the invariant itself needs domain-specific extension.
sents.zh: 第三，目前的可移植性结论仅基于两个领域；扩展到内容审核、知识库摄取以及隐私与效用权衡的数据发布，将能确定在分诊门控处仅改变角色设定是否足够，还是该不变式本身需要针对领域进行扩展。

sents.en: Fourth, replacing the LLM-as-judge evaluation labels with independent human annotation would strengthen the HaluEval evidence base, and identifying a fully free-tier Arbiter matching Claude Sonnet-level performance on objective hallucination tasks remains an open engineering problem.
sents.zh: 第四，用独立的人工标注替换大模型作为评判者的评估标签，将强化 HaluEval 的证据基础；而在客观幻觉任务上找到性能与 Claude Sonnet 相当的完全免费层级的仲裁者，仍是一个待解决的工程问题。

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated records increasingly populate the enterprise systems where output quality and inspectability are operational requirements. When a single record both satisfies and violates a quality rule, no static validation layer can resolve the conflict: the tension is semantic, and resolving it requires deliberation between parties with opposing biases, not a threshold check. The question this paper asked is whether a deterministic check over structured inter-agent records can catch the quality defects that referential checks alone miss, and whether those records carry enough information to audit pipeline quality without calling an additional model.
paragraphs.zh: 由大语言模型生成的记录正日益充斥于企业系统之中，在这些系统里，输出质量与可检查性已成为运营层面的要求。 当同一条记录既满足又违反某条质量规则时，任何静态校验层都无法化解这一冲突：这种张力是语义层面的，化解它需要的是在具有相反偏好的各方之间进行审慎商议，而不是一次阈值检查。 本文提出的问题是：对结构化的智能体间记录进行确定性检查，能否捕获仅靠引用式检查所遗漏的质量缺陷，以及这些记录是否携带足够的信息，使得无需调用额外模型就能审计流水线的质量。

paragraphs.en: We addressed that question by redesigning the data path: two adversarial roles from distinct model families exchange typed claims over peer-to-peer rounds, a three-family quorum adjudicates, and a combined invariant validates the result. The semantic component fires on verdicts that referential checks miss; removing the iterative loop drops invariant satisfaction by nearly 30 percentage points on the BBQ Disability ablation; and the deliberation layer, data model, and invariant transfer from stereotype to hallucination remediation with only role-framing changes, raising right-answer recovery by 49 points, with the triage gate as the one domain-sensitive component. Every claim, vote, and instruction is stored as a typed record that an operator can query without re-invoking any model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过重新设计数据通路来解决这一问题：来自不同模型家族的两个对抗性角色在对等轮次中交换类型化声明，由三个模型家族组成的仲裁团进行裁定，并用一个组合不变式来验证结果。 语义组件能够捕捉引用检查遗漏的裁定结果；在 BBQ 残障消融实验中，移除迭代循环会使不变式满足率下降近 30 个百分点；而协商层、数据模型和不变式仅需更改角色设定即可从刻板印象修复迁移到幻觉修复，将正确答案的恢复率提升 49 个百分点，其中分诊门控是唯一对领域敏感的组件。 每条声明、投票和指令都以类型化记录的形式存储，操作员无需重新调用任何模型即可查询这些记录。

paragraphs.en: The contribution is a portable template. Any task where a record both satisfies and violates a quality rule can instantiate the data model by defining domain-appropriate claim types, assigning advocate roles with opposing biases, and keeping the same combined invariant. More broadly, data-management discipline can now extend, with auditable runtime guarantees, to records produced by LLMs, the records that increasingly populate the enterprise systems where inspectability is becoming a deployment requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的贡献是一个可移植的模板。 任何记录既满足又违反某条质量规则的任务，都可以通过定义适合该领域的声明类型、分配带有对立偏见的倡导者角色智能体，并保持相同的组合不变量，来实例化该数据模型。 更广泛地说，数据管理规范现在可以以可审计的运行时保证，扩展到由大语言模型生成的记录，而这些记录正日益充斥着可检视性正成为部署要求的企业系统。
